name: homologia
description: Validates one closed Homologia manifest and its declared JSONL vectors into deterministic, cap-bounded checked inputs; mirror execution and verdicts still refuse.

interface.shortDescription: Validates one closed Homologia manifest and its declared JSONL vectors into deterministic, cap-bounded checked inputs; mirror execution and verdicts still refuse.
interface.longDescription: Homologia checks whether one pinned Solidity computation and one pinned TypeScript or Python mirror can be compared over declared integer vectors. Version 1.1.0 validates one closed manifest, exact scale identity, safe paths, fixed caps, canonical integers, declared tolerances and proved, recorded or asserted expected-answer provenance. It binds the admitted source bytes into one deterministic checked-inputs record. It executes no mirror, compares no answers and produces no verdict, so the record establishes neither agreement nor correctness.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $homologia to validate this declared manifest and its expected-answer provenance into checked inputs, or state why mirror execution and a verdict are not yet available.
